message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine features two men in military uniforms against a solid magenta background. On the left, a man in a green camouflage uniform and a green beret is positioned behind a second man. The first man’s left arm is wrapped around the second man’s waist. The second man wears a grey, black, and white pixelated camouflage naval uniform. He is shaking hands with a third, unseen person whose white sleeve and hand enter from the right. The second man’s left arm is raised with an open palm. Both men are depicted in profile, looking toward the right.

The top of the cover displays white text: “Musim Gugur Bisnis Startup H.88” and “Akhirnya, Anwar Ibrahim H.110”. A barcode and QR code are in the upper right. Large white letters spell “TEMPO” across the top. Bottom-right text reads: “PANGLIMA YANG TERTUNDA”, followed by smaller text starting with “Presiden Joko Widodo menunjuk Kepala Staf TNI Angkatan Laut Laksamana Yudo Margono...”. The lower edge contains a small, partially obscured tagline: “...NAK D... DAN PERLU”.
